notes.title: Tech Demo Released – Available Now on Patreon for FREE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!I’m beyond excited to finally release the [b]Tech Demo[/b] for my car game project – a huge step toward turning my dream into reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310606/ec95fc28c40a6dab9cf0e9d244f1f876a75546cd.png[/img]

This game isn’t about selecting parts from a menu and hitting "build." Building a car – even a virtual one – is far from simple. It’s complex, messy, and incredibly satisfying. You have to hunt down rare parts, fine-tune your suspension, adjust your air-fuel ratios, dial in boost levels, and make sure everything works together like a real machine would.

That’s the heart of this project: to recreate the real experience of building a car from the ground up. Not just the visuals, but the entire process – engine assembly, part fitting, and tuning for performance.

In this Tech Demo, you can experience the early foundation of what I’m creating. It features:

🔧 [b]Front-end car assembly[/b]

🛠️ [b]Engine building process[/b]

💥 [b]Basic damage system[/b]

🏁 [b]And most importantly – driving![/b]

There’s also a test map included where you can take your car out for a spin, feel how it handles, and get a taste of the physics and mechanics I’ve been working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310606/5cf685c0fc6e45aebf0c193cdbb1b30b5e32fc62.png[/img]

This is just the beginning, but it means a lot to me to finally share something playable. I hope you enjoy testing it out as much as I’ve enjoyed building it.

Thanks so much for your support – it truly keeps this project going. I can’t wait to hear your thoughts.
[b]patreon.com/NextBuild[/b]

notes.title: NextBuild Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We’re excited to share some updates about the development of NextBuild! The game is actively being developed, and we’re making great progress. We’re aiming to release a demo in Q1 or Q2, so stay tuned for more details as we get closer to that milestone.

To stay updated, be sure to follow us on our social platforms where we’re sharing sneak peeks and updates regularly. We're also preparing a Discord server for our community, where you’ll be able to connect with other players, share feedback, and get the latest news directly.

Additionally, we've uploaded new videos on TikTok showcasing some of the exciting features and gameplay elements we’ve been working on. Make sure to check them out and give us a follow for more behind-the-scenes content.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to share more of NextBuild with you soon!

Happy Building,
The NextBuild Team
